title: EcoSystems
description: Protect your world from pollution and total chaos!
body:
# 🌍 EcoSystems: The Balance of the World in Your Hands

Take survival in Minecraft to a whole new level! **EcoSystems** introduces a living, interconnected mechanic based on three core pillars: **Fauna, Flora, and Pollution**. Every single action you take has a direct impact on the ecosystem of the chunk you are in. Will you be a protector of nature, or the architect of an environmental apocalypse?

---

## ⚙️ Core Features

### 🌿 Flora & 🦌 Fauna in Peril
The world reacts dynamically to how you treat its resources and inhabitants. 
* **Deforestation:** If you chop down too many trees without replanting, the **Flora** level will drop drastically.
* **Overhunting:** Killing too many animals causes the **Fauna** level to plummet. When fauna is critically low, **wolves will become aggressive**, attacking players and other animals alike in a desperate struggle to survive.

### 🏭 The Threat of Pollution
Running too many active furnaces at once will rapidly increase **Pollution** levels. If you don't plant trees to purify the air, the environment will quickly spiral out of control:

* **🌧️ Ash & Acid Rain:** The sky will darken, dropping ash from above. If pollution reaches extreme levels, the rain turns into acid, damaging anyone exposed to it.
* **🌾 Stunted Agriculture:** Crops will grow significantly slower due to the lack of nutrients and clean sunlight.
* **☣️ Toxic Air:** Breathing becomes a nightmare. Staying too long in a polluted chunk inflicts constant damage. If you ignore the warnings and remain exposed, you will eventually face a fatal **lung failure**.
* **🐄 Mutations:** Extreme toxicity and radiation can cause terrifying **mutant cows** to spawn in the area.

### 🌐 Chunk-Based Propagation (Dynamic Expansion)
The system is fully localized and realistic. Pollution is calculated **per chunk**. However, toxicity doesn't stay trapped: if a specific chunk reaches critical pollution levels, **it will gradually contaminate its adjacent chunks**, spreading the environmental disaster across your world.

---

## ✨ Commands & Permissions

| Command | Description | Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/es info` | It displays information about the ecosystem of the chunk where you are standing... | `op` |

---

## 🛠️ Survival Tools

To thrive in this unforgiving environment, you have access to essential tools:

* **🕰️ Eco-Meter (Condition Tracker):** Right-click the air while holding a **Clock** to display the exact Fauna, Flora, and Pollution levels of the chunk you are currently standing in.
* **🎭 Gas Mask:** Craft a custom gas mask to protect yourself from toxic air and prevent the deadly side effects of pollution while working in industrial areas.

---

## 🚀 Installation

Getting started is simple and seamless, with no extra setup required:

1. Download the **EcoSystems** `.jar` file.
2. Drop it into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Start (or restart) your server, and the ecosystem simulation will begin immediately!

---

> **💡 Developer's Tip:** Don't forget to plant trees! They are your best defense against the spread of pollution. Good luck trying to maintain the balance of your world!
>
